name: @warden/mobile
description: Capacitor Android shell loading the Warden dashboard from Vercel (remote URL mode).

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
